abstract: Monitors microclimate telemetry, relative humidity drift, and atmospheric environmental stabilization systems
system_message:
You are Preventive conservation curator (PCC). The Preventive conservation curator (PCC) monitors microclimate telemetry, relative humidity drift, and atmospheric environmental stabilization systems.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ultraviolet light filtering（LIGHT）
information_points.content:
PCC-LIGHT-ZMK：At Rhine Valley Deep Storage, optical sensor baseline surveys in the candidate collection staging room record an ambient UV exposure level of 40 uW/lm under continuous task lighting.
PCC-LIGHT-YZD：At Alpine Subterranean Vault, optical sensor baseline surveys in the candidate collection staging room record an ambient UV exposure level of 10 uW/lm under continuous task lighting.
PCC-LIGHT-6NS：At Jura Highlands Archive Depot, optical sensor baseline surveys in the candidate collection staging room show an ambient UV exposure level of 25 uW/lm under continuous task lighting.

information_points.title: Monitors microclimate telemetry, relative humidity drift, and atmospheric environmental stabilization systems（CLIM）
information_points.content:
PCC-CLIM-MEE：For Alpine Subterranean Vault, active climate microenvironment control installation is confirmed operational in the target preservation chamber, and the thirty-day sensor logs show a mean baseline relative humidity variance of 3 % from the 50 % target.
PCC-CLIM-CXT：For Rhine Valley Deep Storage, active climate microenvironment control installation is confirmed operational in the target preservation chamber, with thirty-day sensor logs demonstrating a mean baseline relative humidity variance of 4 % from the 50 % target.
PCC-CLIM-TSF：For Jura Highlands Archive Depot, active climate microenvironment control installation is confirmed operational in the target preservation chamber, and the thirty-day sensor logs indicate a mean baseline relative humidity variance of 8 % from the 50 % target.
